title: Unique Midnight Egyptian Shrimp Skewers
description: A floral and springy Egyptian dish featuring shrimp, paste, and kapi, perfect for a midnight craving. This nut-free friendly recipe is cooked to perfection on a raclette grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together kapi paste, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Dip each skewer into the double fry coating, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the coated skewers on the preheated raclette grill and cook for 8 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Increase the grill temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the coating is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the grill and serve immediately.
